entries.title: The witch hates Christmas
items: 18 new lines: she hates Christmas, bans all Christmas lights and swears she'll tear them down
12 new threats: lawyers, the police, 'If this were America, I'd sue', 'You better watch out, young man'
8 new notes in Chris's mailbox and under the door
Test links (?at=) never drop you inside a building any more

entries.title: Wider, real Bowlinghallen
items: Bowlinghallen built from your own design: 5 lanes, VHS racks, arcade, pool table, WC, café
Glass double door that swings open on the side entrance, with the BOWLINGHALLEN sign above it
Second sign facing Åmotsvegen
90s music inside the hall

entries.title: Market vendors and spawn
items: A stall-keeper at each of the 4 market stalls on the square, with things to buy (G)
You now start and respawn on the square
Dev panel: SET SPAWN HERE button

entries.title: Dev panel: more tools
items: Eyedropper: I or middle-click copies whatever is under the cursor
20 new Christmas lights: strings, street garlands, icicles, roofline bulbs, curtains, arches, light trees, globes, reindeer
TV tower (60 m and 100 m)
Mailbox and the real mailbox stand at Krågehølen

entries.title: Chris's place
items: Chris's mailbox: look at it to see new letters, G to read notes from Downstairs
Wreaths removed from shop doors
Gutted the brick building at Hageteigen: one big open hall

entries.title: Sky and screen
items: Clouds you can fly through
On-screen clock
Clean film mode: H hides absolutely everything

entries.title: 17 town details
items: Parked cars in car parks (and no more buried cars)
Snow banks, road poles, bus stops and a bus, crossings and signs, bins, benches, bike racks
Candle arches and paper stars in house windows, julenek and nisse on the square
People with kick-sleds, prams and dogs, sledding kids, snowmen, chimney smoke
Church bells on the hour, playgrounds, icy river edges with reeds and boats
Sounds: snow crunch, passing cars, river, distant dogs, shop doorbells

entries.title: Fixes and new things
items: No more getting stuck on the ground or in midair
Extra: real entrance, floor and ceiling
Martin's tennis court in the right place
White, wider bridge (Stjerneporten) with green panels
Eye on/off button in Movie mode
Jetpack in your inventory (slot 5)
Dev panel for editing the world
